title: 2 Years Later, Hunter x Hunter Returns From Hiatus With New Update – Read Now
content: Hunter x Hunter is finally back from a two year hiatus with a brand new chapter of the series as Yoshihiro Togashi has returned to the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine.

title: 'Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen 2nd Season' Second Cour Announced for Fall 2026
content: • The 12th and final episode of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen 2nd Season ( Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 ) ended with the announcement of a second cour on Sunday. The official website also revealed an announcement promotional video. The second cour is scheduled to premiere on MBS and TBS in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: One Piece’s Latest Tragic Backstory May Have Just Revealed a Major Twist About Brook
content: One Piece ‘s latest chapter continues Brook’s backstory and, by its end, also brings it to a close. However, as the final chapter depicting Brook’s poignant story, it may have also unveiled a major twist surrounding the character that perhaps no one saw coming.
